title: User-owned cross-game mapping decisions (mappings/manual_mappings.json, committed). v3: radio_effect is a slot-level flag; audio.fx_request removed (migration: mapping_store.migrate)
description: The ONLY place CE and MCC identifiers meet. IDs only: no game text, no custom subtitle text, no local paths (those live in the git-ignored manual_mappings.local.json). Every decision is made by the user; tools never create approvals. Audio and subtitle are independent. See docs/dialogue-catalog-design.md §5.

ce_build.description: Campaign Evolved exe FileVersion the decisions were made against.

added_takes.description: Added takes (owner, 2026-10-17; docs/added-takes-design.md): extra recordings for a sound beyond its Spain takes, inserted by M6 after the Spain takes, with the Spanish .lst.bin rewritten. Optional and additive (absent = none; never written empty).

own_sets.description: Own take sets (owner, 2026-10-18; docs/custom-take-set-design.md): sounds whose Spain takes are dropped, so the sound plays only its added takes. Optional and additive (absent = none; never written empty).

edit_recipe.description: Non-destructive edit recipe (common/audio_edit.py). {trim_start_s, trim_end_s, gap_s} all 0 = no edits (the original pipeline). speed and gain_db were removed on 2026-10-09 (owner decision; one-time migration scripts/validate/migrate_reset_speed_gain.py; volume is the global export gain in config/audio_export.json). The legacy, always-off loudness setting was removed on 2026-10-23 (owner; migrate_remove_loudness_field.py): a recipe holds no level setting, the build's level_mode sets every line's level. The optional fields (added 2026-10-09, no migration needed) are written together by the M4 editor; their rules (ranges, timeline, for_source = the audio source) are checked by the validator and the builder. Part of the audio decision: immutable once approved.

interference.description: One-off transmission interference (owner prompts 44-45, 2026-10-13), allowed only for Victor 933's damaged transmission (common/interference.LINES; docs/victor933-interference.md). An intensity curve (points t/v, 0..1) on the source timeline drives speech ducking (removed at >= 0.95) and MCC's continuous static; guides are the owner's 11 phrase decisions (drawn and reported, never applied by themselves).

texture.description: The static: made from scratch, or MCC Spain's sample (absent = mcc).

edit_combine.description: Two Campaign Evolved lines in one replacement (owner request 2026-10-19; common/audio_combine.py). mode 'concat' (source ce_concat): part 1, then part 2, each with its own edit recipe (no radio/echo/interference in a part), gap_s seconds between them (negative = they overlap and both play). mode 'mix' (source ce_mix): both play at the same time, unedited, the second starting offset_s seconds after the first (negative = the first starts later). Equal levels; if the sum would pass the peak ceiling it is lowered just enough (reported). radio / echo apply to the combined result. for_sources = the audio sources, in order.

radio.description: Optional radio filter (owner request 2026-10-13; added without a migration, absent = no filter): band-pass low_hz..high_hz with slope_db_oct on each side, presence peak at the band centre, tanh drive, channel hiss (noise_dbfs, null = none), optional MCC clicks. Applied by common/audio_edit.py after the edits, before the level stage. preset is a label; the stored numbers are what renders. Part of the audio decision.

presence_hz.description: Optional presence centre (absent = the band's geometric centre).

clicks.description: MCC's Spain radio key-up click before the line and release/squelch after it (common/radio_clicks.py). Absent = false (recipes from before 2026-10-13 evening).

echo.description: Optional echo (owner request 2026-10-13, the 'eco' lines; absent = none): a short slap tap (slap_db null = off), a main echo at delay_ms / echo_db with optional feedback (null = one repeat), diffusion (allpass smear) and damping (low-pass in the echo path, null = none). Applied by common/audio_edit.py after the radio filter, before the level; the line gets longer by the ring-out. preset is a label.

source.description: keep_original: Spain audio stays. ce: one CE line. ce_concat: CE lines in order (the Studio and M6 support 2, owner request 2026-10-19). ce_mix (2026-10-19, added without a migration): 2 CE lines played at the same time. user_recording: one local recording. composite: >=2 sources of any kind, in order. mute (owner request 2026-10-15, added without a migration): the line is omitted from gameplay; M6 writes digital silence of the original sample's exact length (docs/mute-language-permutations.md §1).

mute_reason.description: Why the owner muted the line. Required when source is 'mute' and only allowed then. Part of the audio decision (immutable once approved).

edit.description: The recipe: for one CE line (source ce) an edit recipe (edit_recipe, common/audio_edit.py); for two CE lines joined (ce_concat) or played at the same time (ce_mix) a combine recipe (edit_combine, common/audio_combine.py). Part of the audio decision: immutable once approved.

added_take.description: One added take of a sound. Same audio rules as a line (tools never approve; approved changes only through needs_rework, revision + 1), source 'ce' only. No subtitle: the sound's subtitle is shared by all its takes, so only sounds without a SU/SP subtitle entry may get added takes (validator).

position.description: Order among the sound's added takes (1 = first after Spain's).

own_set.description: One sound in 'own take set' mode. Turned on by an explicit user action, which clears the sound's line decisions; M6 drops the sound's Spain samples only when at least one of its added takes is approved and eligible (otherwise Spain's takes stay).

state.description: Optional (docs/replacement-set-conversion.md). Absent = active. 'staged': a conversion of the sound's per-take decisions is prepared but not switched on; the line decisions stay in force and the takes it created are not built.

own_set_subtitle.description: Optional (owner, 2026-10-19; docs/custom-take-set-design.md §2.1): the ONE subtitle of a sound that has a SU/SP entry and plays its own take set (every take shows the same text). Same lifecycle as a line's subtitle: tools never approve; approved = immutable except a user needs_rework (revision + 1). Sources: keep_original (MCC text stays), ce_locres (a CE line's text), custom (owner text; the text stays in the git-ignored manual_mappings.local.json), none (an empty entry). Applied by M6 only while the set is in force and the subtitle is approved.

own_set_provenance.description: Recovery record of what the set replaced, written once and read-only afterwards (store rule); only activated_at is set when a staged set is switched on. kind 'conversion': made from the sound's per-take decisions; 'replace': the line's 4th audio option (new recordings).

slots.description: The sound's line decisions exactly as they were (approvals, revisions, fingerprints, notes, flags).

added_takes.description: The sound's added takes as they were before.

custom_subtitles.description: Custom subtitles the replaced decisions refer to. The text stays in the git-ignored manual_mappings.local.json; this pins which text it was.

takes.description: The set's takes: created by this record, or added takes the sound already had; from_mapping_ids are the line decisions whose selected audio the take carries.

spec_sha256.description: Hash of the take's audio specification when the record was made (CE line, language, effective recipe): an edit made afterwards is seen.

acknowledged.description: Review codes the owner confirmed when staging.

mcc_key_hash.description: Target row in SP_Halo1.bin. Must stay null until blocker B1 yields a verified link.

radio_effect.description: Owner's manual 'Needs radio effect' flag (v1.1 metadata for the build pipeline; no effect is applied). Independent of the audio and subtitle approvals: toggling it never changes an approved object. It may only be true while the audio uses selected CE audio (validator).

different_but_fits.description: Optional owner flag (added 2026-10-08, no migration needed): the matched CE dialogue differs from the MCC line, but the owner judges it fits the scene. Same rules as radio_effect: independent of approvals, every change bumps its revision; may only be true while the match lists CE lines (validator). Missing = not marked.

needs_recording.description: Optional owner flag (added 2026-10-11, no migration needed): the line needs a new recording (for example, no Campaign Evolved line fits). Independent of the audio and subtitle approvals; every change bumps its revision. Written only once first marked; missing = not marked.
